talent_vocab_note: CORRECTED 2026-09-04 (user ruling, FINAL): the ADAPTATION TALENT (innate) is the OC's OWN NATURE — part of him, not an external tuner; because it is him, it DEPENDS ON HIM, and its effect works on EVERY SINGLE PART of him — body, mind, voice, reflexes, coordination, emotions, instincts, social sense — every function, comprehensive. Concretely (user-specified): very strong, handsome, intelligent, and 'all things' — as his nature, human-level, never a superpower. The 'human ceiling' framing is REPLACED — do not frame the talent as a ceiling or 'the peak of every human attribute'. The talent is USER-GOVERNED — its specifics are decided by the user, not invented. The ADAPTABILITY ABILITY (the Miraculous of Adaptability: active camouflage, Versa-Staff, Evolution!) is COMPLETELY A DIFFERENT THING — not the talent amplified, and the talent not its base; the Cuff adds a different thing, it does not make the talent 'more'. The talent must be written as witnessed excellence + adaptation under pressure (the crowd notices, the camera finds him, the crisis shows his steadiest/strongest self), NEVER as invisibility or backgrounding. PROSE LAW: in every 3-chapter window, at least one chapter in which the OC is present must show talent vocabulary.
